Read finished HaploBreedR results from disk or memory

Source: R/hgsi-io.r
hbr_read_results.Rd

Loads the output of [haplobreed_analysis()] — either the in-memory result or its output directory — into one object that carries the trait direction, the effective gate settings, the PCs the run adjusted for (none if it used no PCs), the tested and superior gene lists, the functional SNPs per gene, the phenotype table, and the publication-style results table. [hbr_advanced_decision()], [hbr_regate()] and [hbr_haplotype_blocks()] consume runs the same way.

Usage

hbr_read_results(
  x = NULL,
  trait = NULL,
  phenotypes = NULL,
  phenotype_id_col = "ID",
  gate_params = NULL,
  path = NULL,
  traits = NULL
)

Arguments

x

A [haplobreed_analysis()] result, a pipeline output directory, a named character vector of directories, or a named list of results. **Alternatively**, the legacy arguments `path` and `traits` (see below) are still honoured.

trait

Trait label; default the pipeline's stored `Trait`.

phenotypes

Optional wide data.frame (ID column plus one column per trait, plus PC columns if the run used PCs). Needed only when the run used PCs and is read from files, because `phenotype_data_used.csv` does not carry the PC columns.

phenotype_id_col

ID column of `phenotypes`. Default `"ID"`.

gate_params

Optional named list overriding the stored gate settings (`alpha`, `min_d`, `min_ind`, `min_hap_freq`, `maf_min`, `trait_threshold`, `require_fdr`, `hedges`). Unspecified entries keep the values stored by the pipeline.

path

Legacy alias: a single pipeline output directory.

traits

Legacy alias: a named character vector of pipeline output directories, one element per trait.

Value

An object of class `hbr_run` (a list), or a named list of them classed as `hbr_run_list`. Elements of a run:

`trait`, `direction`, `mode`

run identity and the trait direction (`"higher"` or `"lower"`)

`gate`

effective gate settings

`phenotype`, `pcs`, `pc_cols`

trait table and PC columns

`gene_snps`

functional SNPs per tested gene

`tested`, `superior`, `superior_label`

gene lists

`table`, `table_source`

publication-style results table and the file it came from

`summary`, `pipeline_summary`

the pipeline-summary row

Details

A single pipeline directory or result returns one `hbr_run`. A named character vector of directories or a named list of results returns one `hbr_run` per element, classed as `hbr_run_list`.

See also

[hbr_regate()] to re-apply the gate with different settings, [hbr_haplotype_blocks()] to group superior haplotypes into blocks.

Examples

toy <- system.file("extdata", "hgsi_toy", "trait_YLD",
                   package = "HaploBreedR")
if (nzchar(toy) && dir.exists(toy)) {
  run <- hbr_read_results(toy)
  run$trait
  length(run$superior)
  head(run$table)
}
